description: Individual lore entries for young, adult, and elder Skywhales.

entries.title: Young Skywhale
entries.summary: Curious young Skywhales travel in herds, sing across great distances, and embody the beauty of the open sky.
body: Young Skywhales hover even in turbulent weather and generate powerful pressure shifts simply by passing overhead. Their deep songs fascinate listeners, while their tails can create strong defensive gusts.
They are generally playful and peaceful, appearing in stories as comforting signs that the aerial ecosystem remains healthy.

sections.heading: Legacy Stat Block
body: The source includes fifth-edition defenses, attacks, Whale Song, Massive Presence, and Gust of Wind values. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Adult Skywhale
entries.summary: Solitary adult Skywhales are immensely strong, widely traveled, and sought for their understanding of the sky's rhythms.
body: Adults move through difficult weather with mastery and resist efforts to redirect or restrain them. Their calls inspire dread, while wing, tail, and tidal movements can reshape the immediate environment.
Sages treat their migrations as sacred journeys and believe their songs preserve memories of shattered continents and the Abyss.

sections.heading: Legacy Stat Block
body: The source includes fifth-edition attacks, Tidal Call, Great Behemoth, and Tsunami Surge values. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Elder Skywhale
entries.summary: Ancient Elder Skywhales are living legends believed to guard balance between the sky and the Abyss.
body: Their presence carries an aura of age, power, and wisdom. Songs may place listeners into profound trances, while their movement can produce world-shaking surges of air and water.
Many cultures regard elders as celestial protectors who guide lost ships and calm dangerous winds. Draconic factions sometimes view them as unnatural rivals placed by higher powers.

sections.heading: Legacy Stat Block
body: The source includes colossal fifth-edition statistics, legendary resistance, Elder's Presence, Tsunami Surge, and Whale Song. Conversion is required.
